quotes.edges: read from the intent's own five-column edge-coverage table (Edge | Criterion | Category | Disposition | Detail) for the edge-to-criterion rows, and the edge-to-suite mapping stated by this census because this plan's ## Held-out checks holds nothing out: it reads 0 held-out row(s) and 8 coverage row(s), so 8 edge row(s) over the criteria ["SC1","SC2","SC3","SC4"] each get one claim and one suite - ["E1 -> scripts/ds-tokens.test.mjs","E2 -> scripts/ds-tokens.test.mjs","E3 -> scripts/token-baseline.test.mjs","E4 -> scripts/token-baseline.test.mjs","E5 -> scripts/panel-styles.test.mjs","E6 -> scripts/ds-tokens.test.mjs","E7 -> scripts/panel-bundle-budget.test.mjs","E8 -> scripts/ds-tokens.test.mjs"] - and every criterion's claim cites every suite its own edges name. The plan's ## Held-out checks and its ## Intent coverage table disagree at 0 row(s) [], recorded under evidence.plan.disagreements rather than refused, because the census scripts/navigation-blocking.test.mjs refuses to derive across the two tables and holds this record to the list
quotes.citations: every citation is a line this checkout carries at capture: 15 test-declaration citation(s) over ["scripts/ds-tokens.test.mjs","scripts/token-baseline.test.mjs","scripts/panel-styles.test.mjs","scripts/panel-bundle-budget.test.mjs"], each opened at the line it states and each held to the test title that line declares, and 32 further line citation(s) over the eight edge claims, each opened and read back

why: No row is required, and the record therefore names no driver, no instance and no verdict path: scripts/overlay-verdict-claims.test.mjs refuses a list with no required row that names a driver, so naming one would be the opposite defect.

The reason is not convenience. A required row must name the driver a control-ai-browsers run expression takes to the wave gate, and that driver must return the gate's four readings - toolElements, drawnRect, descriptor and noDevContext. Every fact the 4 criteria this milestone declares is written about is a fact about the stylesheet's own text, the record that measured what it renders and the 12 stage(s) of the check chain; none of them is an element's rect or a dev context, so naming a driver would make the gate return a page reading for a claim about the page's stylesheet.
The portal is not lost by that ruling: each reason names the clause that would have made a row required, and each claim names the suite, the test, the line and the commands that prove it.

capture.reading: an armed run re-derives the record from the intent this checkout binds, its five-column edge coverage, the four suites this milestone ships and the lines this checkout states, and writes it only when a value moved; a default run reads the file and asserts it is exactly what this head derives, naming the field that moved when it is not, and the writer refuses a candidate that is not the fixed point of this pin.

claims.criterionText: One token block declares the density, colour, type and motion properties, and every value the panel renders resolves through it rather than from a literal at the point of use; a mutant that drops a token reddens naming the property.
claims.reason: The charter's portal clause makes a verdict required where an insurance-portal route can produce a criterion's facts. SC1 is "One token block declares the density, colour, type and motion properties, and every value the panel renders resolves through it rather than from a literal at the point of use; a mutant that drops a token reddens naming the property." - a fact about this repository's own stylesheet, the record that measured it and the suites that hold it, which no route of any page produces: a page renders computed values, and no page reading can say whether a declaration reads a token, whether the token block precedes its readers or whether a build is newer than the source it carries, so a portal-backed row would name a driver that cannot carry the answer.
